$comment: Shared Divider bindings, used by every theme. Divider binds its colour to the palette and its thickness as raw pixels; these make both reachable. Defaults are Spectrum's own values.

bindings.reason: Spectrum binds gray-200, used far beyond Divider.
Spectrum binds gray-800 at size L.
Thickness at size M; shipped code has no token for it.
Spectrum rounds the ends by the thickness.
Thickness at size S; shipped code has no token for it.
